Specification. No.: SR1/N T/W-IT/DOM/B00/26/15128 1. Qualification of Bidder will be based on meeting the minimum pass/fail criteria specified below reg arding the bidder’s technical experience and financial position as demonstrated by the Bidder’s Responses in the corresponding Bid Schedules. 2. Technical experience & financial resources of any proposed subcontractor shall not be taken into account in determining the Bidder’s compliance with the qualifying criteria. 3. The employer may assess the capacity and capability of the bidder, to successfully execute the sc ope of work covered under the package within stipulated completion period. This assessment shall inter-alia include (i) document verification; (ii) details of works executed, work in hand, anticipated in future & the balance capacity available for the present scope of work; (iii) past experience and p erformance; (iv) customer feedback; (v) Banker's feedback; etc.

1 Technical Experience: 1.1 Bidder must have successfully supplied and installed Desktop/All-In-One computers/Workstations a s a contractor during the last 07 years as on the originally scheduled date of bid submission as per following: i. One single work for not less than Rs. 86.88 lakhs (80% of cost estimate excl. GST) ii. Two works, each for not less than Rs. 54.30 lakhs (50% of cost estimate excl. GST) iii. Three works, each for not less than Rs. 43.44 lakhs (40% of cost estimate of excl. GST ) In case, bidder is a holding company, the technical experience referred at clause 1.1 above shall b e that of holding company only (i.e., excluding its subsidiary/group companies). In case bidder is a subsidiary of a holding company, the technical experience referred to in clause 1.1 above shall be of that subsidiary company only (i.e., excluding its holding company). 1.2 The Workstations of proposed Make/Brand/OEM must have been successfully supplied, installed an d operational for a minimum of 07 nos. for at least 01 year under single work order as on the origin ally scheduled last date of bid submission (soft copy) mentioned above. 2 Financial Position: 2.1 The Minimum Average Annual Turnover * (MAAT) for the best three years i.e., 36 months out of last fiv e years of the bidder should not be less than Rs. 162.90 Lakhs. Note-1: * Annual Gross Revenue from operations/Gross operating income as incorporated in the profit & loss a ccount excluding other operative income / Other Income. Note-2: (i) Relaxation for Start-ups^ Start-ups^ shall also be considered qualified if they meet Eighty (80) % of the requirement specified at para 2.1 above in Financial Position. ^ Start-ups as defined by DIPP, applicable as on the originally scheduled last date of bid submission. (ii) Relaxation for MSEs: For MSE Bidder requirement of MAAT is waived off. 2.2 In case bidder is a holding company, MAAT referred to in clause 2.1 above shall be that of the holding company only (i.e. excluding its subsidiary/group companies). In case bidder is a subsidiary of a holdin g company, MAAT referred to in clause 2.1 above shall be that of the subsidiary company only (i.e. ex cluding its holding company). 2.3 The bidder shall furnish documentary evidence in support of the qualifying requirement stipulated ab ove. 1. Bidder shall have to fill and upload the following forms along with their bid: (a) Information regarding Ex-Employees of POWERGRID in bidder’s organization (Refer Form No . 1). (b) Certificate from the OEM in line with PPP-MII Order, regarding the percentage of the local conte nt and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made.

(To be submitted on Letter-head of the OEM). Or Affidavit of Self Certification regarding Minimum Local Content in line with PPP-MII Order (This affidavit to be prepared on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/-). (Refer Form No. 2). (c) Certification by the Bidder per order no. F.No.6/18/2019-PPD dated 23/07/2020 issued by Publi c Procurement Division, Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India ( DoE Order) (Refer Form No. 3). (d) Declaration by the bidder regarding events encountered pursuant to Buyer added A TC Sl. No. 2. (II) (Refer Form No. 4) (e) Manufacturer Authorization Form (Refer Form No. 5) (f) Format for Information for e-payment, Provident Fund (PF) details and declaration regarding M icro/Small & Medium Enterprises (Refer Form No. 6) (g) Declaration by the bidder for ‘Code of Integrity for Public procurement’ (Refer Form No.7) (h) Declaration by the bidder regarding adherence to the POWERGRID Whistle Blower a nd Fraud Prevention Policy (Refer Form No.8). (i) Integrity Pact on Rs.100/- stamp paper -02 sets (Refer Form No.9) The evaluation of bids submitted by bidders shall be carried out based on the s ubmission of soft copies of the document. . 6.
